trails.name: Ocean Path
trails.trailhead: Upper Sand Beach parking lot; access also at Thunder Hole and Otter Point.
trails.description: Follow Acadia's granite coastline between Sand Beach, Thunder Hole and Otter Cove.
trails.season_note: NPS lists year-round use. This describes general seasonality; current access needs a separate check.
trails.restrictions: Rocky and uneven sections, staircases and coastal drop-offs. Dogs must be leashed.
trails.permit_note: Trail-specific permit requirements are not reported in this source. Review official NPS guidance.
trails.source_title: Hike Ocean Path Trail (U.S. National Park Service)

trails.name: Jordan Pond Path
trails.trailhead: Jordan Pond Boat Launch, near the North Lot.
trails.description: Circle Jordan Pond beneath Penobscot, Pemetic and the Bubbles, with boardwalks and rocky shoreline.
trails.restrictions: The western half is more difficult than the eastern half. No swimming or wading in the public water supply. Leashed dogs only.
trails.permit_note: Trail-specific permit requirements are not reported in this source. Review official NPS guidance.
trails.source_title: Hike Jordan Pond Path (U.S. National Park Service)

trails.name: Gorham Mountain Loop
trails.trailhead: Southwest corner of Gorham Mountain parking lot.
trails.description: A rocky mountain-and-coast loop with views toward Cadillac Mountain and the ocean.
trails.season_note: NPS lists spring, summer and fall.
trails.restrictions: Uneven footing and scrambling. The optional Cadillac Cliffs section includes rungs and ladders. Dogs must be leashed.
trails.permit_note: Trail-specific permit requirements are not reported in this source. Review official NPS guidance.
trails.source_title: Hike Gorham Mountain Loop (U.S. National Park Service)

trails.name: Vernal Fall Footbridge
trails.description: Climb from Happy Isles to a viewpoint of Vernal Fall from the footbridge.
trails.season_note: NPS describes winter closures on sections of the Mist Trail and John Muir Trail; a different winter route may be needed.
trails.restrictions: Pets and bicycles are prohibited. Waterfall spray can make steps slippery; follow the official route and current restrictions.
trails.permit_note: Trail-specific permit requirements are not reported in this source. Review official NPS guidance.

trails.name: Lower Yosemite Fall Loop
trails.description: A short paved loop to views of Upper and Lower Yosemite Falls.
trails.season_note: NPS lists year-round access, winter ice, and a waterfall that is often dry from late July or August through October.
trails.restrictions: Leashed pets and strollers are allowed; bicycles are prohibited. Stay on the paved trail.
trails.permit_note: Trail-specific permit requirements are not reported in this source. Review official NPS guidance.

trails.name: Mirror Lake out and back
trails.description: Look up toward Half Dome and Tenaya Canyon; the longer route continues around the lake.
trails.season_note: NPS lists year-round access with winter and early-spring snow/ice. The lake is fullest in spring and early summer.
trails.restrictions: Pets and bicycles are allowed only on the first paved mile. Stay on trails and bridges.
trails.measurement_note: The source labels 100 feet as 'Elevation'; it is not published here as elevation gain.
trails.permit_note: Trail-specific permit requirements are not reported in this source. Review official NPS guidance.

trails.name: Riverside Walk
trails.trailhead: Temple of Sinawava, Zion Canyon shuttle stop 9.
trails.description: Follow the Virgin River on a mostly paved route into narrowing canyon walls.
trails.season_note: NPS lists year-round use but warns of winter closures on icy sections.
trails.restrictions: Pets are not allowed. Some sections have irregular paving and drop-offs.
trails.measurement_note: Length and gain come from the source's February 2025 accessibility assessment.
trails.permit_note: Trail-specific permit requirements are not reported in this source. Review official NPS guidance.

trails.name: Pa'rus Trail
trails.trailhead: Zion Canyon Visitor Center or Canyon Junction.
trails.description: A paved route along the Virgin River, linking views of the Watchman, river habitats and interpretive exhibits.
trails.restrictions: Leashed pets and bicycles are permitted. The museum connector has different accessibility and pet/bike restrictions.
trails.measurement_note: The official page contains differing length descriptions. Distance is withheld pending route-scope reconciliation.
trails.permit_note: Trail-specific permit requirements are not reported in this source. Review official NPS guidance.

trails.name: Delicate Arch
trails.trailhead: Delicate Arch Trailhead at Wolfe Ranch.
trails.description: Climb exposed slickrock to Arches' iconic free-standing arch.
trails.season_note: NPS advises avoiding midday summer heat and notes winter ice on the narrow ledge.
trails.restrictions: Dogs are not allowed. The source describes exposed ledges and no drinking water at the trailhead.
trails.permit_note: Trail-specific permit requirements are not reported in this source. Review official NPS guidance.
trails.source_title: Delicate Arch Trail (U.S. National Park Service)

trails.name: Landscape Arch
trails.description: A hard-packed path through Devils Garden to a thin ribbon of sandstone.
trails.season_note: NPS notes drinking water at the trailhead is seasonal, from spring through fall.
trails.restrictions: Dogs are not allowed. Steep slopes near the arch may require accessibility assistance.
trails.permit_note: Trail-specific permit requirements are not reported in this source. Review official NPS guidance.
trails.source_title: Landscape Arch Trail (U.S. National Park Service)

trails.name: South Rim Trail
trails.trailhead: Multiple access points between South Kaibab Trailhead and Hermits Rest.
trails.description: Walk selected sections of the mostly paved South Rim path for canyon overlooks.
trails.restrictions: Stay on designated trails and walkways. Review the official source before choosing a section.
trails.measurement_note: 13 miles describes the full trail, not a recommended out-and-back hike. Choose a suitable segment.

trails.description: A relatively flat out-and-back walk to Fairy Falls.
trails.restrictions: The source prohibits pets and off-trail travel in thermal areas. Review current park conditions and backcountry guidance.

trails.name: Grand Prismatic Overlook
trails.description: A gradual climb to views over Grand Prismatic Spring and the Midway Geyser Basin.
trails.restrictions: Stay on established trails; off-trail travel in thermal areas is prohibited. Pets are not allowed.
trails.permit_note: Trail-specific permit requirements are not reported in this source. Review official NPS guidance.

trails.name: Watchman Trail
trails.trailhead: Zion Canyon Visitor Center: follow the plaza sidewalk past the shuttle stop to the crosswalk, then follow the river to the trail.
trails.description: Climb from the river to an overlook of the Watchman, lower Zion Canyon, sandstone towers and Springdale.
trails.season_note: NPS lists year-round use, with potential muddy or icy conditions in winter and monsoon season and limited summer shade. This is general guidance, not a current condition report.
trails.restrictions: NPS prohibits bikes and pets. The route has sandy, rocky, uneven surfaces and drop-offs.
trails.measurement_note: The 3.3-mile distance describes the published round trip. NPS accessibility data gives separate overlook and loop segments; a full-route total elevation gain is not reported and is not inferred by summing segments.
trails.permit_note: NPS lists no reservations, but this does not establish all permit or current access requirements. Park entrance fees apply; check official guidance.
